_readme: Emberclimb music cues, wave 1. Each cue has 2 versions (a and b). Save as games/emberclimb/music/<cue>-a.mp3 and <cue>-b.mp3 (menu-a.mp3 ...); the game registers only the files that exist, so no code change is needed. No vocals. Slots: menu, map, fight, boss loop; victory, defeat play once.

menu.prompt: Instrumental fantasy game menu theme, no vocals, no spoken words, slow 70 BPM, warm cello and low harp, a distant ember-crackle texture, hopeful but weary, sparse and calm, 4-bar intro then 16-bar sections, ends on a whole bar so it loops cleanly, mixed for a phone game. Make 2 versions (a and b).

map.prompt: Instrumental fantasy exploration theme for climbing a tower, no vocals, no spoken words, 90 BPM, plucked strings and soft hand drums, mysterious and steady, light wind pad, understated so it can play for minutes, 4-bar intro then 16-bar sections, loops cleanly, mixed for a phone game. Make 2 versions (a and b).

fight.prompt: Instrumental fantasy card-battle theme, no vocals, no spoken words, 120 BPM, driving low strings ostinato, war drums on beats 1 and 3, brass stabs now and then, tense but fair, 4-bar intro then 16-bar sections, loops cleanly, mixed for a phone game. Make 2 versions (a and b).

boss.prompt: Instrumental fantasy boss battle theme, no vocals, no spoken words, 140 BPM, heavy taiko and low brass, urgent staccato strings, rising choir-free synth pad, huge and threatening, 4-bar intro then 16-bar sections, loops cleanly, mixed for a phone game. Make 2 versions (a and b).

victory.prompt: Short instrumental fantasy victory fanfare, no vocals, no spoken words, 100 BPM, bright horns and harp arpeggio resolving to a warm major chord, triumphant, plays once, ends clean with a short tail. Make 2 versions (a and b).

defeat.prompt: Short instrumental fantasy defeat sting, no vocals, no spoken words, 60 BPM, low cello and a fading bell, somber and quiet, descending to a minor chord, plays once, ends clean with a short tail. Make 2 versions (a and b).
